jobs.name: p5d
jobs.prompt: Medieval winter night at the Low Ford, deep dark: a black starless sky. Looking down a rutted dirt road that climbs toward us from a river ford in the middle distance at the centre of the picture. At the ford, three crude open fire baskets of black iron bars on short black iron posts stand on the near bank, solid black silhouettes with cold pale blue fire cut into them; no glow, no glass, no lantern. In the middle of the river a fourth light: the same kind of crude black iron cage of cold blue fire hangs just clear of the water, a faint glare above it hiding whoever holds it, rings carved on the water under it. The black river carved in long horizontal gouge lines catching the blue. Snow on the banks only, carved in dim moonlit blue-gray. Bare black winter trees on both sides frame the road. On the road in the middle ground a wooden wagon lies overturned on its side, one wheel in the air. Along both sides of the road run flooded ditches of black water. Both ditches are full of the drowned dead, many of them, standing in the water: gaunt corpses in waterlogged rags clinging to them, long hair plastered with river weed, heads hung, arms hanging, one or two pale hollow-eyed faces, water running off the hems, varied heights, spacing and turn, lit only by the cold blue. Everything else is black and deep blue-black ink; the only light is the cold blue fire.
